items.computation: Posting day stated in the letter: 02.01.2026 (Friday) ('Dieser Bescheid wurde am 02.01.2026 zur Post gegeben'). Per §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter posted by the tax office counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 06.01.2026 (Tuesday). That day is Heilige Drei Könige, a public holiday in Bayern, so under §108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed-delivery day shifts to the next working day: 07.01.2026 (Wednesday). Counting the one-month Einspruch period under §355 AO / §108 Abs. 1 AO with §187 Abs. 1 BGB (the day of delivery is not counted, period starts 08.01.2026) and §188 Abs. 2 BGB (ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day), one month after 07.01.2026 falls on 07.02.2026 (Saturday). Since that is a Saturday, §108 Abs. 3 AO shifts the deadline to the next working day: Monday, 09.02.2026.
